puzzles.name: Lantern Color Match
puzzles.description: Cycle the lantern between red, green and blue until it matches the wall sigil.
puzzles.unlockCondition: All sigils match the lantern colour at once
puzzles.failureState: Sigils reset; minor sanity drain

puzzles.name: Three-Lantern Sort
puzzles.description: Sort three lit lanterns onto the plate bearing their own colour.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Each colour rests on its matching plate
puzzles.failureState: Plates clear and lanterns return to neutral

puzzles.name: Echo Sigil Sequence
puzzles.description: Watch a short sigil sequence flash, then repeat the same presses on the altar.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Target sequence replayed without an error
puzzles.failureState: Sequence reshuffles; one sanity drain

puzzles.name: Tile Step Pattern
puzzles.description: Step across floor tiles in the order shown by the brief highlight pattern.
puzzles.unlockCondition: All tiles light up in the target order
puzzles.failureState: Tiles dim and the pattern restarts

puzzles.name: Twin Plate Gate
puzzles.description: Stand on one plate and push a crate onto the other to open the gate.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Both plates stay down for two seconds
puzzles.failureState: Plates release and the gate stays shut

puzzles.name: Counterweight Match
puzzles.description: Fill the scale with household objects until the pointer sits inside the marked band.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Scale balanced within tolerance for one second
puzzles.failureState: Weights return to their starting slots

puzzles.name: Ghost Plate Holder
puzzles.description: Record a short echo so the ghost holds the far plate while you cross to the near one.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Echo holds the far plate while you hold the near one
puzzles.failureState: Echo dissolves and both plates release

puzzles.name: Silhouette Lock
puzzles.description: Move the lantern until its cast shadow fits the silhouette drawn on the screen.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Shadow overlaps the drawn silhouette
puzzles.failureState: Silhouette returns to its neutral outline

puzzles.name: Orbiting Shadow
puzzles.description: Hold two shadows inside their outlines while the lantern swings on a slow arc.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Both shadows stay aligned through one full swing
puzzles.failureState: Swing restarts from the centre

puzzles.name: Three Knocks
puzzles.description: Knock three times on the pillar, leaving a short pause between each knock.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Three knocks are answered in order
puzzles.failureState: Knocking pattern changes

puzzles.name: Melody Answer
puzzles.description: Listen to a short melody on the pillar, then hum it back by pressing the tone stones.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Melody replayed note for note
puzzles.failureState: Melody resets with a soft dissonance sting

puzzles.name: Beam Bender
puzzles.description: Rotate two mirrors so the lantern beam reaches the receptor across the room.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Beam lands on the target receptor
puzzles.failureState: Mirrors snap back to their neutral angles

puzzles.name: Prism Split
puzzles.description: Split one beam through prisms and aim both halves at separate receptors.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Both receptors are lit without crossing a beam
puzzles.failureState: Beams retract and prisms realign

puzzles.name: Glyph Key
puzzles.description: Translate the carved glyph key and enter the matching three-symbol word.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Entered glyphs match the carved key
puzzles.failureState: Glyphs scramble but the key stays visible

puzzles.name: Mirrored Glyph
puzzles.description: Read glyphs from a mirror and enter them in the order they appear in the reflection.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Reflected glyphs are entered in the right order
puzzles.failureState: Mirror darkens and the glyphs reset

puzzles.name: Pendulum Press
puzzles.description: Press the switch as the pendulum crosses the marked centre line, three times running.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Three presses land inside successive windows
puzzles.failureState: Pendulum resets its phase

puzzles.name: Two-Beat Lock
puzzles.description: Answer a visual flash and its audio tick on the same beat to arm the latch.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Both cues are answered on the same beat
puzzles.failureState: Cue pair desynchronises and restarts

puzzles.name: Quarter Turn
puzzles.description: Rotate the room in ninety-degree steps until the exit lines up with the walkway.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Room rotated until the exit aligns
puzzles.failureState: Room returns to zero degrees

puzzles.name: False Perspective
puzzles.description: Shift the viewing angle until separated planks read as one continuous bridge.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Shifted platforms form a continuous walkway
puzzles.failureState: Camera snaps back to the default angle

puzzles.name: Fuel for Passage
puzzles.description: Spend a quarter of the lantern charge to release the latch on the passage gate.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Fuel spent and the gate latch released
puzzles.failureState: Fuel refunded and the latch drops back

puzzles.name: Two Candles
puzzles.description: Pour fuel into two counterweights to balance a scale that opens the inner door.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Both counterweights filled from the reserve
puzzles.failureState: Fuel refunded and the weights empty

puzzles.name: Rising Tide
puzzles.description: Open the valve in stages so the floating crate rises to the high alcove.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Float platform lifts to the alcove
puzzles.failureState: Water drains back to the low mark

puzzles.name: Wind Lift
puzzles.description: Aim two fans so a gust carries the fallen laundry off the latch.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Gust carries the cloth clear of the latch
puzzles.failureState: Fans stop and the cloth settles back

puzzles.name: Thaw and Climb
puzzles.description: Light the candle, melt the ice, let the water feed the vine, then climb the ledge.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Ice melts, water grows the vine, vine reaches the ledge
puzzles.failureState: Ice reforms and the vine withers

puzzles.name: Hidden Embers
puzzles.description: Four embers are revealed briefly, then hidden; touch each one from memory.
puzzles.unlockCondition: All hidden embers touched after the reveal
puzzles.failureState: Embers rehide in new slots

puzzles.name: Hidden Order
puzzles.description: Remember both the places and the order of five embers, then touch them in sequence.
puzzles.unlockCondition: Hidden objects touched in the revealed order
puzzles.failureState: Order reshuffles and objects rehide
